name: Rust Monster

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.description: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft., one nonmagical metal object worn or carried by a creature, or a nonmagical metal weapon used to hit the rust monster. On a hit, the item corrodes: a weapon takes a cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls (destroyed at -5), and a suit of armor takes a cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it grants (destroyed once the penalty reaches -10).

description: Rust monsters home in on the scent of iron and steel, corroding armor and weapons to feed on the oxidizing metal that flakes away.
